campaign.name: Beat the surface code at k=100, weight-8, unrestricted

direction.hypothesis: An unrestricted weight-8 code at k~100 can beat 100 independent surface patches on kd^2/n.

bar.note: Holey rotated surface code k=105 as nearest multi-logical baseline.

direction.feasibility: Unrestricted weight-8 cell supports n up to 1000 at w<=8, d<=40.

novelty.claim: First systematic k~100 frontier probe in this cell

direction.expected_value: An unrestricted weight-8 code at k>=95 on the cell frontier would be a milestone result.
direction.what_a_negative_would_teach: Whether unrestricted weight-8 constructions can reach k~100, or whether the cell saturates earlier.
